title: Summarize the verified runtime boundary
instruction: Summarize the supplied runtime status in two concise sentences. Describe the verified behavior and the remaining work.
input: One RWO command was persisted before calling ARE. ARE routed a native Codex turn to Luna and verified its completion. RWO accepted the terminal event. Workspace displayed the matching command and completion receipts. Replay made zero additional provider calls. General task launch controls, multiple workers, automatic recovery and MCP are not implemented.
